control.label: Control
control.subject: Reddit: the history follows you between phones on the Reddit Google Sheet. You › History, the posts read (what Unread only leaves out) and the searches go to the sheet's History, Read and Searches tabs and come back from them, merged three ways (reddit/public/hist.js), so what one phone opened, cleared or marked unread reaches the others; something taken off on one phone but opened again on another since stays. Sent a few seconds after a change, at start, when the app comes back to the front and when the internet is back; with no internet it stays on the phone and goes later. Set up under You › Google Sheets with the setup QR (new app `reddit` in adblock/lib/setup.mjs and Control's QR list) or a pasted phone-setup.json. The sheet's requests go out through Warranty's Http bridge (net.js), Reddit's own still through MainActivity; the APK gets the camera for the QR. Asked: "save reddit history to a google sheet so it saves between devices". Tests: hist.test.mjs (9, three mutants each red), page.mjs G checks (25) against a stand-in Google that refuses writes past a tab's grid (taking out the grid sizing = 2 red); javacheck 11 unit tests; Ad Block 26. page.mjs's V check (the list's picture copy) was already NOT OK before this change.

planner.label: Planner
planner.subject: Planner: a Remind tab of timers (design B, Dial). Type what it is, turn the dial to how long (minutes round once, each lap past the top an hour more, up to three hours), set Again every (Off, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 min) and Start: it rings then, and again every so often until it is ticked. Running timers sit as rings across the top counting down (red once rung, "Rang 3 times"); a tap on one gives +5 min and Done. The widget's + has To-do | Timer at its top: Timer is the name, a slider of minutes, Again every and Start, without opening the app. Before it rings a quiet notification counts down to it (Done, +5 min); at its moment it rings with Done and In 5 min, on an alarm clock so it is on the second even with the phone asleep. A timer is a to-do with a Ring at moment (Checklist column N), so it syncs, shows on the widget and ticks like any other; timers come first. Proof: javacheck 94/94 (6 new: timer rings and repeats, once, sheet round trip, order, the slider, words); page e2e passes (new: dial drag across laps and held at 1 min and 3 h, Again every, Start, rings counting down and turning red, +5 min, Done, the Checklist line, the form keeps it a timer); real Chromium drags round the dial and it fits a 412 x 860 screen (e2e/remind-chromium.mjs); 10 mutants red. Not seen on a phone yet (no emulator on the Pi). Asked: "remind me in one minute, five minutes, 10 minutes with constant notification so that I won't forget, or like a custom time frame", then "B".

reddit.label: Reddit Snoo
reddit.subject: Reddit Snoo: only the posts read go to the Google Sheet. You › History and your searches stay on the phone, no longer sent to the Reddit sheet; the Read list (what Unread only leaves out) still follows you between phones. The first sync of this version takes the old History and Searches tabs off the sheet itself, rather than emptying them now by hand: a phone still on the older version would read an emptied tab as "cleared on another phone" and empty its own History. Proof: hist.test.mjs 9/9 (with the old hist.js, "only Read goes to the sheet" is red); page e2e every G check passes (new: only a Read tab, the old tabs taken off, opening a community writes nothing, History and searches on the phone untouched by a sync); without the tab removal 2 checks go red. The one other red check (V, the list's picture copy) was red before this change. Asked: "dont save searches haha or no need history actl just read is fine clear it otherwise".

nudge.label: Nudge
nudge.subject: Nudge: nudge every 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes, or a custom gap in seconds, minutes or hours. New task's Nudge row is Once | 1 min | 3 min | 5 min | 10 min | Custom; Custom opens a number and Seconds | Minutes | Hours, with "Every 45 sec until it is done" under it; from 10 seconds to 24 hours, anything else goes red and is not sent; the next new task opens on last time's gap. A task now carries everyS (seconds, tasks.mjs everySOf) and still every in whole minutes, so a phone on the older build nudges every minute for a 30 s task until it updates; tasks from before read every as minutes. Plan.java nudges on everyS, with the early-ring slack at most a quarter of the gap (20 s slack would ring a 10 s task every time); the notification, the cards and the sheet's Nudge every column say it in words (30 sec, 1 h 30 min). Proof: relay 16/16 (new: gaps from seconds to a day, old minutes-only tasks, the sheet's words), javacheck 14/14 (new: seconds between nudges), drive passes (new: the six choices, 5 s refused, 30 s sent and shown on Papa's phone, the sheet, last gap remembered); mutants red: relay ignoring everyS (2 fail), the page sending minutes only (drive), the 20 s slack (PlanTest). On the emulator a task every 15 s rang at +15.003 s and +15.005 s from an exact alarm. Asked: "add 'mumma' and custom like 1 minute 3 minutes 5 minutes 10 minutes and custom for x seconds minutes hours".
